main_text.p: 1. Sa.13.obtulisset holocaustum : {h}Quod si non fecisses, inquit, ad eum Samuel, jam nunc præparasset Dominus regnum tuum super Israel in sempiternum: sed nequaquam Re-gnum tuum ultrà consurget, quæsivit Do-minus sibi virum juxta cor suum, eò[?] quod non servaveris, quæ præcepit Dominus: 1.Sam.15.{i}secundò, quod Amalechitas ad internecionem usque jussus occidere, sibi prædam, & regem Agag incolumem reservaverit. Propterea, inquit, Samuel, quod abjecisti sermonem Domini, abjecit te Dominus ne sis rex. Et paulò post, ab-scidit Dominus regnum Israel à te hodiè, & tradidit illud proximo tuo meliori te. {k}Postcà ex Dei præcepto; tulit Samuel cornu Dei, & unxit David in Regem, & in eum infusus est spiritus Domini à die illo, & in posterum. Spiritus autem Domini recessit à Saul, & exagitabat eum Spiritus nequam. Quare loquu-tus est Saul ad Ionatham filium suum, & ad omnes servos suos, ut occiderent David: quin & ipse, lanceam ad cum cum pariete configendum propria ma-nu ejaculatus est; licèt non ita multò ante, spiritus sui furorem cantu & mu-sica1.Sam.16 17,18,19, 20[?].21,22.

page.notes: The marginal references are printed beside the first line and beside the line "secundò"; the reference marks h and i are in the text. The word "eò" is printed with an accent that I read as a grave on the o, so it carries [?]. The underline under "Quod" is not transcribed as a separate mark. The text continues beyond this part of the page. The first line of the column is italic and continues the sentence from the previous page. The marginal reference is printed as "k1.Sam.16 / 17,18,19, / 20.21,22."; the first digit of the last line is uncertain. The mark "k" in the text is a reference mark. The word "sica" at the line end completes "musica", hyphenated across the line break.
